# ADR 0004: Idempotent import guarded by a PostgreSQL advisory lock

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** FX reference rates service

## Context

Imports can be retried and several instances may run the scheduler.

## Decision

Insert with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; take pg_try_advisory_xact_lock so only one import runs; log runs in REQUIRES_NEW transactions.

## Consequences

Re-runs are harmless; failures are recorded even when the import rolls back.

## Alternatives considered

ShedLock or Quartz clustering (more dependencies).
